notes.title: DRL SIM 4.1 Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello Pilots,

In this release you will find a new map to explore! Silicon Valley brings you an epic soccer stadium, with lively surroundings, gaps, and dives galore. With this map comes the Race in the Cloud track, as well as 4 alternate tracks of different difficulties.

We've also brought to the playing field an update to Pro Pilot mode (Pro Mode + Damage), a crash/shake animation upon impact and crash/impact audio. Also, the ability to adjust the drone trail width while spectating and watching replays. You will now have a Damage symbol in Multiplayer races on the race order panel when another player sustains damage. The crash systems sensitivity has been updated to provide a better experience upon impact.

Tournaments now allow you to go back to previous tournaments and see the entire bracket, check results and replays!

Additional improvements/updates, including:
- 2 new Draganfly drone skins and 4 new Draganfly motors to customize your drone
- 2022-23 Virtual Season tracks
- Opponent bot auto-refresh
- Adjustable intro music via the Settings menu (music volume option)
- Ability to Favorite track on post-race screen
- Added an Exit button to the game footer
- XP has now been added to the Achievements completion
- New Replay markers (checkpoints, crashes, and mid-lap)
- Chat improvements
- Track Editor improvements
- Map improvements (lighting and performance)

Most notable bug fixes:
- Tournament registration issue
- Uncapped Racer4 exploit
- Damage on Racer4 custom physics
- Nano Class Leaderboards
- And many other fixes and improvements

We love hearing all feedback and suggestions, so please let us know what you think of this release!

notes.title: DRL SIM 4.0 Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello Pilots,

We're really excited to share our latest updates with you! The development team has been grinding to bring you a new Onboarding mode, a new Search & Destroy game play mode, a DRL Pilot flight mode, upgraded Replay system, and an irresistible new Mega City map with three (3) brand new tracks! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29022929/1826cb3e0bc1762801b50d6628102acd1cb3518d.jpg
The new Mega City map features a futuristic metropolis where users can navigate the city from above the skyline, around and inside of massive high rise buildings and architectural landmarks, through city streets and urban parks, down through underground highways, through a monorail station and even into a multi-level underground subway station. While this map is addictive to fly in Freestyle mode, we've included expert-designed Basic, Medium, and Hard tracks to accompany this new map; Let's see who can stay atop the Leaderboards on these fresh tracks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29022929/7b0dde8e8a5170570b110d3c9737d5d7f51defb8.jpg
The new Search & Destroy game mode provides a fun and satisfying gameplay experience of destroying target balloons by flying into them. Target balloons of various shapes and sizes are strategically and creatively placed throughout the DRL Sim signature Campground map, along with "danger" balloons that must be avoided, empowering newer pilots with a fun way to level up their skills to begin competing on the more challenging race courses.  

For experienced pilots, Search & Destroy provides a fresh game experience for fine tuning their stick coordination for precision drone control, while also introducing new leaderboards to grind by attempting to "pop" all target balloons in the shortest amount of time. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29022929/74eda0d951e3d439278143ea412f5026e3a3ebde.jpg
The new Onboarding game flow guides newer pilots through a series of progressive training missions and instruction. Pilots will start Onboarding training in an assisted flight Beginner mode completing nine (9) Onboarding missions culminating in a race before progressing to Intermediate, a partially assisted Onboarding flight mode, consisting of 10 missions culminating in another race. Finally,  in Onboarding Pro Mode, pilots will fly unassisted (training wheels completely off) for three (3) races that must be won in sequence to complete Onboarding flight training!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29022929/929b7243fe000c583dfda3872c45653ef3f09277.jpg
The DRL Racer4 is now upgraded to include a throttle cap and battery resistance, with an optional damage setting, to match the setup used by professional DRL pilots during Virtual Season Levels. This allows users to truly train like the pros!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29022929/c761c27bcbedfd7e190d5c5512060e709ee9850c.jpg
This release also unleashes an updated Replay system that uses less RAM while supporting longer Replay recordings. All users will benefit from the faster pre and post race load times, especially when racing with opponent bots. 

Additionally, we've expanded Map Editor capability to support creation of the new Search & Destroy tracks and added a new Geometric Layout tool that enables exponentially faster placement and sizing of large groupings of specific assets in random or pattern configurations.  

We love hearing all feedback and suggestions, so please let us know what you think of this release!

*** Note that with the addition of DRL Pilot mode updates to the stock Racer4, we must reset our Leaderboards with this release and the Replay v2 upgrade is not backwards compatible. For users that update to the v4.0 version, this just means that there will be fresh Leaderboards to top! However, make sure all your friends also update to v4.0, as users that haven't updated from v3.12 will lose the ability to set leaderboard entries, view the replays, and fly against bots ***

Notable Bug Fixes:
- Resolved Leaderboard search issues
- Fixed Tournament system Sudden Death and Golden Heat issues
- Improved overall Tournament system stability
- Enabled Drone crash recordings in Replays
- Resolved Replay system performance issues  
- Rendering improvements on low quality settings to make maps look more consistent
- Exposure calibration on low quality settings to fix either too dark or high exposure maps rendering
- Continued improving console rendering performance for most maps

notes.title: DRL SIM 3.12 Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello Pilots,

Today we are bringing you our latest update. We start this update with some new features courtesy of Allianz. These include a brand new race track called "Allianz Eagle." This track was named for the Allianz Eagle gate, which is our first animated gate in the sim. You can also now use this gate to build your own tracks with it. Allianz also brings us 2 new drone skins and 3 branded motors that you can use on drones you build in the workbench.

This update also includes a number of community requested features including the ability to change the colors of checkpoints and the race line. We have added the ability to reset your leaderboard time on a track.

We also received feedback from pilots who are trying to complete the in-game achievements that it was very hard to know your exact progress on an achievement. To address this, we added a new achievements screen under the profile menu that will show you details on exactly which achievement tasks you still need to complete along with showing the ones you have completed. 

Lastly, the release includes a number of bug fixes, which are detailed below.

Thank you for your ongoing support of the sim. Please let us know what you think of this release as we are always striving to improve.



Bug Fixes
-Resolved issue with multiplayer and tournament rooms being limited at a total of 15 people instead of 21
-Addressed issue with pilots getting hung up in tournaments with a pink screen
-Fixed issue with footer appearing after editing drone and also while loading into races
-Corrected problem with loading bar appearing multiple times while loading in offline mode
-Resolved several null references

notes.title: DRL SIM 3.11 Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello Pilots,

We have another exciting release for you today. We are starting off with our new circuits feature, a campaign mode type of experience. There are 6 new racing circuits for you to fly with each offering 5 race tracks where you will earn a cumulative time after completing all of the tracks in a circuit. You also have the option to race against a bot inspired by a DRL pilot at 4 different difficulty levels. You can see how you stack up with the new circuits leaderboard filter. 

We also are including several community requests in this release including the ability to toggle off drone trails, making the breadcrumbs menus clickable, adding a random option to multiplayer map selection, and adding an option for resetting all of your leaderboard entries.

A release would not be complete without bug fixes. You can find a list of those fixes below.

Please let us know what you think of the release. We are always looking to improve and are open to your feedback. Thanks for your ongoing support of the sim.

Improvements & Bug Fixes

 Resolved issue with map editor not saving work intermittently
 Fixed issue with Goldberg not flying in freestyle when switching to it from pause menu
 Corrected problems with Next and Watch buttons not being available in tournaments
 Implemented better optimization for 3000 series graphics cards
 Fixed missions bug where stars were not awarded consistently across all missions screens
 Disabled multiplayer invites when players are in a tournament
 Updated Tryouts card to reflect 2021 winner
 Fixed bug with tournament results getting moved over a column when a player misses a heat
 Fixed bug with footer appearing in-game when changing drones

notes.title: DRL SIM 3.10 Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello Pilots,

We are bringing you a quality of life update today that contains mostly bug fixes and performance improvements.

It addresses problems reported with the race line, Campground map performance, and some tournament issues.

Speaking of our tournaments, we run community tournaments every Thursday at 5pm EDT (on our NA server) and every Sunday at 3pm EDT (on our EU server). We encourage you to come out and join us. These tournaments are a great way to practice at any skill/experience level.

As with all of our updates, your feedback is encouraged and we always look at it as a way for us to improve. Please reach out to us on Discord or via our help desk if we can assist you with any issues.

Thanks for your ongoing support.

Full list of changes:
-Implemented a number of performance improvements for Campground map
-Multiplayer bots will default to being 7" to get more competitive matchups when using default Racer4
-Fixed issue with players getting stuck between heats in tournaments
-Fixed issue with black screen when hitting restart button during qualifier in tournaments
-Fixed spot in Out of Service where you could fly through the ground
-Removed wifi icon in house map to fix issues with readability when using physics panel on that map
-Adjusted tournament timer so that it shows proper time when qualifier is longer than 1 hour
-Fixed issue with Campground and USAF Night Mode maps where track cards moved around the screen
-Fixed problem with Map Editor not saving work intermittently
-Fixed race line issues
-Resolved issue with MultiGP tall gates
-Corrected problem where user could fly with workbench in the background
-Fixed issue where Biosphere freestyle loads Skatepark instead of Biosphere
-Fixed issue where render scale did not do anything
-Corrected problem where custom bots could not be raced with and it would cause loading into a freestyle version of the map
-Resolved problem where ESC doesn't exit during replay
-Corrected bug where graphics would create unusual effect when landing in the canoe on the Lakehouse

notes.title: DRL SIM 3.9 Release Announcement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29022929/c4ec2b694e1f25964a6a9c4049c7fd784e3fbf61.png
Hello Pilots,
We are excited to bring you our latest update. We start off with a number of big updates courtesy of the U.S. Air Force. The first big update is the introduction of the oft-requested Night Mode, a version of the U.S. Air Force Boneyard at Davis-Monthan Base, with night lighting featuring 3 brand new race tracks. The U.S. Air Force also brings you a number of new features when you are creating your own drones including a rebranded workbench, 3 new U.S. Air Force branded skins, and 2 U.S. Air Force branded motors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29022929/2c361354733e8b25df5d68132d6a842770dc2b68.png
In addition to the U.S. Air Force Boneyard Night Mode, we are bringing you our most graphically advanced map to date, the Campground. This map features a lake, cabins, power lines, cars, bridges, and even a train tunnel for you to fly through. We are kicking off the launch of this map with 4 new tracks for it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29022929/ff438fd2d0b909b7fecb1e48a75a67813d6809e3.png
Next up we have our paid skins feature where we are bringing you our first animated drone skins available for purchase. You can check out these skins under the new “Store” card where you will find skins like “Party Time,” a celebratory skin decked out with animated confetti. Our initial launch includes 2 individual skins available for purchase as well as a pack of 4 skins.

In our last update, we mentioned that our experience points system was being released as a beta. Today, we are simplifying that system where you will have a cumulative level and a weekly level.

We are also adding 3 new achievements today. You can now earn an achievement by winning 5 tournaments, creating 5 maps, and/or building maps that see at least 20 leaderboard times logged on them. 

We’ve heard a number of community requests to add more statistics to the sim. To this end, you will now find information on your fastest lap, slowest lap, number of crashes, and finish percentile (relative to your time on the leaderboard). 

Lastly, we have included a number of improvements including more work on the race line system as well as bug fixes. You can find a complete list of those below.

As always, your feedback and ongoing support are valued. Please let us know what you think of this release as we are constantly striving to bring you the best simulator that we can.

  
Bug Fixes

 Corrected issues with World Traveler achievement
 Resolved problems with camera boxes appearing on tracks
 Reverted multiplayer forced Racer4 default changes to resolved bugs
 Made Bridge map accessible in Map Editor
 Resolved issue with drone rotation on rates screen
 Resolved problems with various loading animations not working/loading
 Fixed problem with network disconnected dialogue message going out of box
 Made additional improvements to race line consistency
 Fixed issue where spectator name and time would not display when using spectator mode

notes.title: DRL Sim 3.8 Release Announcement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29022929/8c5d494ed8232d6d8957570b9cc1f7040a38b994.jpg

Hello Pilots,

You’ve been waiting patiently for the next set of features to come out and today we bring you a monster of a release. 

We start off with two features that have been highly requested - Offline mode and a Favorite System. Yes, you can now play the sim offline when you are traveling or don’t have an internet connection. You can also now put all of your favorite tracks in a single folder, eliminating the need to navigate through multiple menus in between races to find the track you want to race.

Next, we bring you a custom bot feature and bot improvements. For the custom bot feature, you can now race against any player you want from the leaderboard. You can build a field of up to 5 pilots to race against with the new “custom” option in solo race. For the bot improvements, we bring you a default of racing against DRL Racer 4 bots. In the past, you would get matched up against drones from all classes so we wanted to make the competition more even by default.

We are still going strong here with the features as we bring you an achievement system on Steam. You now have 15 achievements that you can earn. You will earn badges based on the achievements you earn.

We also bring you a new track called the Foundry Circuit on Boston Foundry.

The monster release would not be complete without one more major feature. It is our experience points system. You will earn a level over the course of all of your flying based on the tracks you fly (Each DRL track now shows XP and you earn more XP for multiplayer races). You will also earn streak points for every day when you fly 3 DRL tracks. No experience points system would be complete without a badge system, which is reset every week. You can find more details in the sim under “About XP.” Please note that this is in beta and will be adjusted on our next release based on findings. Since we are launching on a Thursday, the weekly ranking (with badges) will reset on Monday as Monday marks the start of the new week.

Please let us know your thoughts. We always appreciate your feedback and are thankful for the engaged community we have that always pushes us further to deliver the best sim we can.




DRL Sim 3.8

Key Features:

 Offline Mode
 Steam Achievements
 Experience Points (XP) (Beta)
 Favorite System

notes.title: U.S. Air Force Boneyard Map Release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29022929/e9d67ba61fc6d4a6fc7c2849dffa4becd7a2a238.jpg

Hello Pilots,

We are excited to bring you a new map today, the U.S. Air Force Boneyard. This map will be used for today’s Fanduel DRL Sim Racing Cup event at 4pm EST. This map will have a freestyle track and 2 race tracks in this release, “Stratotanker” and “Sim Racing Cup 8.” The Sim Cup track will be added shortly when today’s race begins. 

The Boneyard at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base is the world's largest military aircraft maintenance facility and home to thousands of decommissioned aircraft. Although this map is not an exact replica of the real boneyard, it has hundreds of planes including KC-135 Stratotankers, F-15E Strike Eagles and A-10 Thunderbolt II “Warthogs” to fly over and explore. 

We encourage you to check out these new tracks and see how you stack up to your fellow sim pilots.

Thank you for your ongoing support,
DRL Sim Team

notes.title: DRL Sim 2.10 Release Announcement
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29022929/6782b8a5319661cc1f9a346156d34b09b8163c37.png

Hello Pilots,
In this update we’ve mostly focused on improving optimization, performance, and a few graphical updates. We’ve completed our Race2Vegas event and we hope to see some of you in person at The Luxor on Saturday February 9th on the Strip. For those that can’t make it, worry not, we will be streaming all the action on our Twitch channel.

Physics
The following changes are being made to all non-Tryouts related content in order to keep things fair for the event. We’ve fixed issues with PID adjustments and saving custom PIDs, along with some overall performance improvements. 

Multiplayer
We’ve spent some time working on fixing stuttering that can occur when players leave multiplayer lobbies in addition to a few other performance hiccups for an overall smoother experience. 

Art
We’ve added some more MultiGP assets and props to the Map Editor and improved visibility of the Raceline a bit. We’ve polished up our drone rendering in addition to our grass texturing on The Field map. Optimized the Sim to use less memory where possible.
Fixed an issue where the the first checkpoint wouldn’t activate properly when restarting races. 
Resolved issue with Leaderboard standings not updating post race when flying against ghosts.

Physics (Changes only made to non-Tryouts modes)

Fixed issue with PID adjustments counting as custom physics
Fixed issue with PIDs not saving
Performance improvements


Track

Added new track "A Walk in the Park" to Simple Courses


Multiplayer

Worked on improving performance issues happening when players leave lobby


UI

Art

Added new MultiGP assets to Map Editor
Adjusted red line race path brightness

Fixed issue with exclusive mode changing to window mode in some computers
Optimization to make the simulator consume less memory where possible

Thank you for your feedback and support for the Sim, it really means a lot to us. If you want to give more suggestions or just want to hang out with other racers, check out our Discord Server by selecting the Discord Icon in the Main Menu. notes.title: DRL Sim Hotfix for Update 2.9
notes.notes:
Hello Pilots, 

This hotfix is to address an inadvertent push we made on the last release which changed the Racer3 physics thereby impacting Tryouts. 

We have always maintained that we wanted Tryouts to be based on a level playing field throughout the duration of the competition. 

Since altered Racer3 physics can create an unequal playing field, we have reverted this change and adjusted the leaderboards accordingly. 

Please note that this change does not impact the performance improvements that were included in last Thursday's release.

Thanks for all of your feedback and continued support of the Sim, if you have any issues or questions please let us know in the comments, Steam Discussion Page, or on the Help Desk.

notes.title: DRL SIM 2.6 Release Announcement
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29022929/0332f9358770b8ad9e2713c4ed47ddf6305ee7ad.jpg
Hello Pilots,
In this new update we are overhauling the input system to improve the way that controllers are setup for the sim. Users can expect to see improvements in the FS-i6 controllers and many other controllers that are frequently used by the community.
 
We have completely change the UI and the interface for adding a controller, in addition to better informing the user when a controller is not connected properly or at all. You can now click on the Needs Calibration message at the bottom of the screen to be taken straight into the process.
 
We now offer a full manual calibration process in addition to our vastly improved automatic calibration process. Also, we have completely reworked trimming and adjustment of each of the controller channels. No more fumbling with numbers, we now have a much more intuitive system of bars and sliders that will trim to your exact specifications. Gamepad controllers can now have an adjustable deadzone and a zero throttle point when set up for the sim. Users can also set their gamepad triggers to act as the throttle.

Lastly we have added a number of new props for you to use in Garage mode. We’re very excited to see what new Custom Drones you will make. 

As always, we are constantly trying to improve the Sim and make it the best experience it can be. If you find any bugs or have any questions about features, please let us know in the Discussion section of our Community Hub here on steam or submit a ticket to our   Help Desk.

Thank you so much for your continued support of our simulator!
-DRL Simulator Team

notes.title: DRL SIM 2.5 Release Announcement
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29022929/17523874924d20793976ec9084cd3042cd4e84cd.jpg
Hello Pilots, 

With this new update comes the DRL Swatch Tryouts 2019, four new maps, a new nano drone, and a host of other improvements to the Sim. Here is what you can expect from DRL Simulator version 2.5: 

It’s time for the DRL Swatch Tryouts 2019!
It’s our favorite time of the year! We have created an entirely new map to run this year’s Tryouts! This time around, there is only 1 track that you need to run in order to get your invite to Las Vegas for the live eSports Tournament! Like last year, the winner of this year’s tournament will win a $75,000 contract to become DRL’s next professional pilot. Additionally, the 2nd and 3rd place pilots will also earn a contract to fly alongside the Tryouts Champion, and the rest of the DRL Pros in the 2019 season! All pilots will be required to register, make sure you enter your correct emails to stay up to date on the latest news regarding the 2019 Swatch DRL Tryouts. Good luck everyone!

Four New Maps
From the DRL 2018 season comes California Nights and Skatepark LA. Specifically made for the 2019 DRL Swatch Tryouts, comes the Swatch Map.  Lastly, from our sponsor Cox comes The House, the only place you can fly the Shendrones Goldberg nano drone. 

New Nano Drone
The new Shendrones Goldberg drone is the smallest drone in the SIM and you can fly it exclusively in the new map, The House.

New Unsteady Drag Model
Introducing the first Unsteady Drag Model in the world of FPV simulation.  Straight from the laboratory of Georgia Tech, this model allows for drag to be simulated from every flight angle – there is nothing more realistic on earth.  No more magic numbers, wind tunnels are so last year. More details to come as we roll this out to more frames over the next few months.

Camera and FOV Overhaul
We have updated our Camera and FOV systems to better mirror their real life counterparts.

Miscellaneous Changes 
We have improved our Lens Distortion Effect so there shouldn't be anymore black borders.
We've made a host of changes to our physics calculations and to the physics dashboard to improve the experience.
FlySky i6 compatibility and calibration has been worked on and improved in this release. 

Map Editor Changes 
You can now turn off gates as checkpoints in the map editor and select which ones are part of the Race Logic, in short, you have have gates that players do not have to go through to complete a race.
Players are now able to set a ‘Finish Gate’ which will always be the final gate in Race Logic, should make it easier to create tracks with multiple laps and not have to duplicate gates to do so. 

As always, we are constantly trying to improve the Sim and make it the best experience it can be. If you find any bugs or have any questions about features, please let us know in the Discussion section of our Community Hub here on steam or submit a ticket to our  Help Desk.

Thank you so much for your continued support of our simulator!
-DRL Simulator Team

notes.title: DRL SIM 2.2 Release Announcement
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29022929/594898574bfa887e95a21b16e991b1043935e828.jpg
Hello Pilots, 
We’ve got a new update for you all that improves upon a few of the things we introduced in the last update. Here’s what you can expect from DRL Simulator Version 2.2 

Changing Drones: 

We’ve made it easier to change drones during any of our events or activities. You can now change your drone directly through the pause menu without having to go back to the map screen. Be aware that this will restart your current race and change the race class accordingly. 

Physics Dashboard Improvements: 

In addition to some overall tweaking, we have enabled the Physics Dashboard to be accessed from any mode in the game. Players can set and save physics properties for their custom drones on the fly. Please note that race times with your own physics will be marked different from default physics times in order to keep things fair. 

Here’s how it works: 

In race or freestyle you must open the Physics Dashboard from the pause menu at which point your run will be tagged as a ‘Custom Physics’ run until you hit a loading screen and it resets, unless you have a ‘Tuned’ drone but we’ll get to that later. 

Hitting the ‘P’ key now will bring up the dashboard like in the ‘Physics’ level. 

In the Physics Dashboard you can ‘Save’ your current settings you have set to your drone that you are using, the drone then becomes ‘Tuned’. Hitting ‘Clear’ will reset your drone back to default settings. Selecting ‘New’ at the top will save your drone as a community drone, more on that in future updates.

DRL Leaders leaderboard is for stock parts on a default tuned DRL Racer3. Don’t worry, you can still go nuts with the cosmetics and still be official.


If you have any other questions, please leave them in the comments below.

Bugs and Performance: 

We’re hard at work improving the overall experience of the game, we’ve focused this update on improving our quality settings and performance of the game along with general bug fixes. If you’re having any trouble with the SIM or just want to know more, please see our helpdesk  


Thanks everyone!

-DRL Simulator Team

Hello Pilots, 
It’s been a while since our last update but we’ve been busy. We’re happy to announce the launch of DRL SIM 2.1 along with a host of new features and updates. 


Garage Mode: 

One of the most important parts of drone racing is the fine tuning and customization that goes along with building your own drone. In this new update you can now customize the Props, Motor, Battery, Accessories, and Colors of your drone. You can then take your custom drone into any of our single player or online modes. 

Physics (Beta): 

Today the DRL Sim is rolling out the beta version of it’s Physics engine. We are committed to creating the ultimate sandbox for quadcopter dynamics in search of the ultimate feel.

We will also be working to improve things further, so if we’re still not up to your standards let us know. Stay tuned there is much more to come.

Social Features:

Hangout and talk trash with your fellow pilots with our new Social Panel. You will now be able to chat with all the other DRL SIM users in our Global Chat or maybe just message a friend with our Private Chat. Only interested in talking with the folks you’re racing with, try using our Game Chat, all included in the new Social Panel. 

Multiplayer Quickmatch: 

Tired of searching through rooms and regions looking for people to fly with? Now with Quickmatch, you can be placed into a game with the press of a button. This works for both Racing and Freestyle matches. 

New Map:

A new mega map. Out of Service is a large outdoor map modeled after an abandoned airport in the desert. With a mix of planes, cranes, and a very large zeppelin to fly in and around. Along with this map comes a new Freestyle course and 3 new Race courses to try. [spoiler](We’re excited to see if Robogenesis can maintain his top spot.)[/spoiler]

Bugs and Performance: 

In addition to all this new content we’ve also been working to improve the performance and quality of the sim, along with squashing a few bugs along the way. If we missed any please let us know in the discussions section of our Community Hub here on Steam. If you’re having any trouble with the SIM or just want to know more, please see our helpdesk 

Thanks everyone!

-DRL Simulator Team

notes.title: RC Transmitter/controller issue UPDATE!
notes.notes:
DRL High Voltage - v2.0.275-eax

Hello pilots,

As most of you are aware, at launch, High Voltage had some controller issues that made the game challenging to play. Since then, the dev team has been hard at work on a solution and I am happy to announce that these issues have been resolved and an update is now available!

Please update your game to the latest version 2.0.275-eax and take your drone out for a spin!

Thank you all for your patience during this bumpy time and for all your feedback and support!

Happy flying!
